title: Beyond Uncertainty: Multi-Solver Disagreement Rewards for Self-Evolving Reasoning Curricula
abstract: arXiv:2608.30035v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-evolving reasoning frameworks train a Challenger to generate questions exposing a Solver's weaknesses, creating adaptive curricula without human data. However, existing approaches use a single solver's sampling uncertainty as the Challenger's reward. This creates a fundamental bottleneck: as the solver grows confident on the Challenger's question distribution, all sampled answers converge identically, collapsing the reward to zero and starving the Challenger of learning signal. Critically, this single-model reward cannot distinguish genuinely easy questions from those that merely align with one solver's learned biases. We propose a multi-solver disagreement reward using a heterogeneous ensemble varying in model capacity and sampling temperature. A normalized Shannon entropy over the ensemble's per-question plurality answers explicitly rewards questions where solvers produce conflicting solutions---capturing difficulty as inter-model

translated_title: 超越不确定性：面向自演化推理课程的多求解器分歧奖励
translated_abstract: 自演化推理框架通过训练一个“挑战者”来生成能够暴露“求解器”弱点的问题，从而在无需人类数据的情况下创建自适应课程。然而，现有方法使用单个求解器的采样不确定性作为挑战者的奖励。这造成了一个根本性瓶颈：随着求解器对挑战者的问题分布变得日益自信，所有采样答案趋于一致，导致奖励坍缩为零，使挑战者缺乏学习信号。更为关键的是，这种单模型奖励无法区分真正简单的问题与那些仅仅符合单个求解器学习偏差的问题。我们提出了一种多求解器分歧奖励，使用在模型容量和采样温度上各不相同的异构集成。通过对集成中每个问题的多数派答案计算归一化香农熵，明确奖励那些求解器产生相互冲突解的问题——将难度刻画为模型间的
tldr: 提出用异构多求解器集成的答案分歧度（归一化香农熵）替代单求解器不确定性作为挑战者的奖励，解决了自演化推理课程中奖励坍缩为零、挑战者学习信号枯竭的根本瓶颈。
en_tdlr: Proposes a multi-solver disagreement reward—normalized Shannon entropy over a heterogeneous solver ensemble—to replace single-solver uncertainty, addressing the fundamental bottleneck of reward collapse in self-evolving reasoning curricula.
